{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/quenching/brief/subtasks/aluminum_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenching_trial_1/npt_relax.in", "content": "# NPT relaxation of Aluminum structure

units metal
atom_style atomic

create_atoms 1 box
mass 1 26.98

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/quenching/brief/subtasks/aluminum_potential_file_subtask_quenching_trial_1/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Initialize velocities
velocity all create 300 12345

# Define compute for density
compute density all property/atom mass
compute sum_mass all reduce sum c_density
variable volume equal vol
variable density equal "c_sum_mass/(v_volume*1.0e-24)/6.022e23*1.0e3"

# Relaxation
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density

fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0

# Output commands
dump 1 all custom 10000 relaxed.lammpstrj id type x y z
dump_modify 1 sort id

# Run NPT relaxation
run 10000

# Print final density
print "Final_density: ${density}"

write_data relaxed.data"}
